column1: # HAWAIʻI 2027–28: Hawaiʻi Common Core Standards for Mathematics (revised; approved by the Board of Education June 2026; document dated 17 July 2026; elementary grades from 2027–28)
# Exported from Mathness's src/standards/states/hi27.ts (2026-10-01); see references/states/hi.md for sources.
# Codes drop Common Core's cluster letters; K.MD.4 and 1.MD.4 are new, so Common Core's 1.MD.4 is Hawaiʻi's 1.MD.5.
# kind here: same = carries one Common Core standard with no summary of its own; edited = carries one with a changed summary; new = carries none.

column5: Count forward and backward from any number within the known sequence, not just from 1.
Ask questions about the classroom that sorting and counting can answer, and collect the data.
Know the value in cents of a penny, nickel, dime and quarter, and compare single coins.
Count within 1,000, and skip-count by 2s, 5s, 10s and 100s.
Solve money word problems within a dollar with coins and within $100 with bills, using $ and ¢.
Pose questions measurement data can answer; measure lengths to the nearest whole unit and show them on a line plot.
